title: Pretty good!
text: Pretty good!. Use in a fairly small bedroom, does ok but takes awhile to cool down. Not quite but I like the air conditioning noise!

product_metadata.title: FRIGIDAIRE White 8,000 BTU 115V Window-Mounted Mini-Compact Air Conditioner with Mechanical Controls
features: Beat the heat while remaining cool and happy on hot summer days
Control the temperature prolifically with 2344.57 W cooling power
Provides enough cooling in your room with 3 fan speeds
Dehumidification up to 2.3 pints per hour
Mechanical rotary controls with 3 cool speeds and 3 fan speeds to achieve climate control when you need it most with
description: On hot, humid days, Frigidaire's 6,000 BTU window-mounted air conditioner quickly cools a room up to 350 square feet. This mini-compact unit features mechanical rotary controls and top 4-way air direction control. The washable filter with front, tilt-out access captures dust from the air to keep your air conditioner working efficiently. After a power outage, Effortless Restart automatically resumes operating at its previous settings once power is restored. Plus, low power start-up conserves energy and saves you money. Year after year, Frigidaire is the brand you can trust to keep you cool and comfortable.

details.Included Components: Air conditioner, window mounting kit, manual, warranty
